value.rationale: The precise naturally arising quantity is the smallest swimming speed keeping a subject inside a time-varying thermal/oxygen depth interval for one full cycle. Local instantaneous nonemptiness is insufficient, and the proof completely classifies its true dynamic feasibility across all phase lags and widths. The explicit optimal path and sharp change in near-boundary exponents from 2/3 to 1/2 quantify the sensitivity of vertical refuge access to asynchronous limits. This is a complete justified mathematical benchmark, not a calibrated species-level recommendation.
